title: Introduction to Complex Numbers
description: The imaginary unit i (i^2 = -1), powers of i, real and imaginary parts, equality of complex numbers.

title: Algebraic Operations on Complex Numbers
description: Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division of complex numbers.

title: Conjugate and Modulus
description: Conjugate of a complex number, modulus, and their properties.

title: Argand Diagram and Polar Form
description: Geometric representation in the Argand plane, argument, and the polar form r(cos θ + i sin θ).

title: Equations in Complex Numbers
description: Solving linear and quadratic equations whose roots are complex numbers.

title: Types of Matrices
description: Order of a matrix; row, column, square, diagonal, scalar, identity, null, symmetric and skew-symmetric matrices.

title: Algebra of Matrices
description: Addition, scalar multiplication, matrix multiplication and transpose.

title: Determinants and Their Properties
description: Determinants of order 2 and 3, minors and cofactors, and properties used to evaluate determinants.

title: Adjoint and Inverse of a Matrix
description: Singular and non-singular matrices, adjoint, and the inverse A^(-1) = adj(A)/|A|.

title: Systems of Linear Equations
description: Solving systems by Cramer's rule, the matrix inversion method and Gauss elimination.

title: Vectors in Plane and Space
description: Scalars and vectors, position vectors, components, magnitude, and addition of vectors.

title: Unit Vectors and Direction Cosines
description: Unit vectors i, j, k, direction angles and direction cosines of a vector.

title: Scalar (Dot) Product
description: Dot product, angle between two vectors, projection, and the condition for perpendicularity.

title: Vector (Cross) Product
description: Cross product, the condition for parallel vectors, and area of a parallelogram and triangle.

title: Scalar Triple Product and Applications
description: Scalar triple product, volume of a parallelepiped, coplanar vectors, work done and moment of a force.

title: Sequences
description: Sequences, general term, finite and infinite sequences.

title: Arithmetic Progression
description: nth term of an A.P., arithmetic means, and the sum of n terms of an arithmetic series.

title: Geometric Progression
description: nth term of a G.P., geometric means, and sums of finite and infinite geometric series.

title: Harmonic Progression
description: Harmonic progression and harmonic means.

title: Relations between Arithmetic, Geometric and Harmonic Means
description: Relations G^2 = AH and A ≥ G ≥ H for positive numbers.

title: Sigma Notation
description: Notation Σ and properties of summation.

title: Sums of Powers of Natural Numbers
description: Σn, Σn^2 and Σn^3 and series built from them.

title: Arithmetico-Geometric Series
description: Series whose terms are products of corresponding terms of an A.P. and a G.P.

title: Method of Differences
description: Summing series by expressing terms as differences (telescoping).

title: Factorial Notation and Fundamental Principle of Counting
description: n!, and the multiplication and addition principles of counting.

title: Permutations
description: Linear permutations, permutations with repetition, and circular permutations.

title: Combinations
description: Combinations nCr and their properties.

title: Probability
description: Sample space, events, classical probability, and complementary events.

title: Addition and Multiplication Theorems of Probability
description: Mutually exclusive and independent events, and the addition and multiplication laws.

title: Principle of Mathematical Induction
description: Proving statements for all natural numbers by mathematical induction.

title: Binomial Theorem for Positive Integral Index
description: Expansion of (a + b)^n, binomial coefficients and their properties.

title: General Term and Middle Term
description: The (r + 1)th term, middle term(s), and the term independent of x.

title: Binomial Series for Any Index
description: Expansion of (1 + x)^n for negative or fractional n with |x| < 1, and approximations.

title: Functions, Domain and Range
description: Definition of a function, domain, codomain and range.

title: Types of Functions
description: One-one, onto and bijective functions; even and odd functions; linear and quadratic functions.

title: Composite and Inverse Functions
description: Composition of functions and the inverse of a bijective function.

title: Graphs of Functions
description: Graphs of linear, quadratic and modulus functions, and graphical solution of equations.

title: Linear Inequalities
description: Linear inequalities in two variables and their graphs as half-planes.

title: Feasible Region
description: Systems of linear inequalities, the feasible region and its corner points.

title: Optimization by Corner Point Method
description: Objective functions, and maximizing or minimizing them over a feasible region.

title: Fundamental Law of Trigonometry
description: cos(α − β) = cos α cos β + sin α sin β, and deductions from it.

title: Sum and Difference Formulas
description: sin, cos and tan of the sum and difference of two angles; allied angles.

title: Double and Half Angle Identities
description: Identities for sin 2θ, cos 2θ, tan 2θ, and half angles.

title: Product-to-Sum and Sum-to-Product Formulas
description: Converting products of sines and cosines into sums, and vice versa.

title: Solution of Right Triangles
description: Solving right-angled triangles, and angles of elevation and depression.

title: Law of Sines, Cosines and Tangents
description: Solving oblique triangles with the laws of sines, cosines and tangents.

title: Half Angle Formulas and Area of a Triangle
description: Half-angle formulas in terms of sides, and area of a triangle including Hero's formula.

title: Circles Connected with a Triangle
description: Circum-radius, in-radius and escribed radii.

title: Domain, Range and Period of Trigonometric Functions
description: Domain, range and periodicity of the six trigonometric functions.

title: Graphs of Trigonometric Functions
description: Graphs of sin, cos, tan and their reciprocals over given intervals.

title: Inverse Trigonometric Functions
description: Principal values, domains and ranges, graphs, and identities of inverse trigonometric functions.

title: Solution of Trigonometric Equations
description: General solutions of trigonometric equations, and solutions within a given interval.
